info.title: SUtech Transport API
info.description: Generated from the front end's Zod schemas (npm run openapi). Fields are snake_case, times are ISO 8601 UTC, money is integer piasters, errors are { code, message }.

post.summary: Step 1 of sign-in for every role: texts a one-time code to the account's registered phone. Errors: UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER (404), ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403), OTP_LOCKED (429), OTP_RATE_LIMITED (429).
Step 2: the same identifier plus the code. Returns a bearer token that carries the role. Errors: INVALID_OTP (400), OTP_EXPIRED (400), OTP_LOCKED (429).

get.summary: The signed-in account and its role. 401 when the token has expired or was revoked.
Server health and current server time (UTC).
Lines open this term, with price, bus type, free seats and the first pickup time. Names follow Accept-Language.
One line with its stops in order (name, landmark note, morning pickup time, map pin). Errors: LINE_NOT_FOUND (404).
The student's subscription for the current term, or null if they have none. The server moves an unpaid reservation to expired (and frees the seat) once hold_expires_at passes.

post.summary: Books a seat on a line at one stop and holds it for 24 hours until a receipt arrives. The price is fixed now. Errors: SEAT_UNAVAILABLE (409), ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED (409), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), STOP_NOT_ON_LINE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Cancels a reservation that is not paid yet and frees the seat (to pick another line or stop). Paid subscriptions go through a refund request instead. Errors: NOT_CANCELLABLE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Term price, the university's bank account (NBE) and the offices for paying by Visa. Office hours follow Accept-Language.
The student's receipts this term, oldest first, each with its review status.

post.summary: Uploads a bank deposit or transfer receipt for a reserved seat. The seat stays held while finance reviews it. Errors: HOLD_EXPIRED (409), NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT (409), RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED (409), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413), AMOUNT_MISMATCH (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The active subscriber's digital pass with a fresh signed QR token (valid 30 seconds). The app calls it again just before the token expires. Errors: NOT_SUBSCRIBED (403).

The active subscriber's next trip: date, their stop and pickup time, the bus, and where the bus is now (from its GPS device). trip is null for students without an active subscription. Live changes arrive on the WebSocket as bus.location and trip.status.

Announcements for the caller, newest first: official notices for everyone, and delays or changes on the caller's own line. Optional `kind` filter. Text follows Accept-Language. Published by the Transportation office (admin pages, later phase); each new one also creates an `announcement` notification.
The student's line change, refund, complaint and model permit requests this term, newest first, each with its status history. Office notes follow Accept-Language.
The term's refund table, today's deduction (Cairo date) and the amount the student paid. From the server so the dates change each term without a new app.
One of the student's own requests. Another student's request answers 404.

post.summary: The university's line change form: new line and stop, permanent or temporary (with dates), the reason, and the guardian's approval. Needs an active subscription. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), SAME_LINE (422), INVALID_DATES (422), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), STOP_NOT_ON_LINE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Cancels the paid subscription and asks for a refund under the term's refund policy, with the guardian's approval. An ordinary refund is refused once the deduction reaches 100%; medical, bereavement and transfer cases are decided by the university and need documents. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), REFUND_WINDOW_CLOSED (422), DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED (422), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: A complaint to the Transportation office (driver, delay, bus condition, crowding, safety, payment, other), with optional photos. Payment complaints need a booking; the others an active subscription. Errors: NO_SUBSCRIPTION (409), NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), INVALID_DATES (422), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The university's safety permit to bring a project model onto the bus: material, size, purpose and destination, entry and exit date and time, the doctor or TA responsible, and the student's liability declaration. The server fills the student's details and the bus (their own line) from the account and subscription; the office adds the driver later. Signed by the doctor/TA, then the Safety department. Needs an active subscription. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), INVALID_DATES (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The student takes back a request the office hasn't started on yet. Errors: NOT_WITHDRAWABLE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The caller's notifications, newest first, with the unread count. New ones also arrive live as the `notification.new` event; the app re-reads this list when one comes in. Text follows Accept-Language.

post.summary: Marks every notification read. Returns the new unread count (0).
Marks one notification read (already read: no change). Returns the new unread count.

get.summary: The active subscriber's reported "not going" days from today on, and the next service days they can still report (7 days ahead, today until the bus leaves the line's first stop). Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409).

post.summary: "Not going" for one service day (both trips). The driver, the supervisor, the guardian and the Transportation office are told, and the student is not marked absent that day. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), DATE_NOT_REPORTABLE (422), ABSENCE_CUTOFF_PASSED (409), ALREADY_REPORTED (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Takes back a "not going" report before the bus leaves the line's first stop; the same people are told the student is riding after all. Errors: ABSENCE_CUTOFF_PASSED (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The student's trips this term, newest first: boarding and arrival scans, absences, "not going" days and check-outs with their reason, plus a count of each. Optional `outcome` filter. Text follows Accept-Language. Empty for a student who never rode.
